title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
summary: 本課以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為主線，從裂後承載與纖維橋接與力位移曲線的能量積分建立系統邊界，再把拔出功與界面滑移、荷重位移同步與零點連到性能規格與試法交接。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction. It begins with Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging and Energy integration of force-displacement curves, links Pullout work and interface slip and Force-displacement synchronization and zero, and ends with Performance specifications and method handover. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查裂後承載與纖維橋接：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60；再獨立檢查力位移曲線的能量積分：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。平均力由 20 增為 22 kN、位移仍為 25 mm，能量由 500 增為 550 J；試板尺寸或支承變更時不能沿用這個比例。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 將比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Independently check Energy integration of force-displacement curves: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J. At a fixed 25 mm travel, mean force rising from 20 to 22 kN increases energy from 500 to 550 J; changed panel geometry or support prevents direct transfer. The two results are not a complete design because panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Use compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「力位移曲線的能量積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" and "Energy integration of force-displacement curves": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂後承載與纖維橋接」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂後承載與纖維橋接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance. Inspect the complete postpeak curve rather than comparing maximum loads alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂後承載與纖維橋接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 纖維沿噴射方向及流動方向重新排列，跨越裂縫的角度影響法向傳力。餘弦可用來投影單根已知纖維的力，卻不能直接計算跨縫根數；根數還受位置、長度及三維取向分布控制，必須透過切面或影像取樣描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載；若出現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纖維方向與法向力分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer. A cosine projects a known fibre force but does not directly count crossings. Counts also depend on position, length and three-dimensional orientation, requiring section or image sampling rather than a force-projection shortcut. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fibre orientation and normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。拔出功屬單根纖維與試件的組合，不能不考慮互相干擾便乘上所有纖維數；嵌入長度及端部形狀要隨試驗一起報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拔出功與界面滑移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance. options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平均纖維用量符合就不需要檢查分散均勻度
對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing mean fibre dosage removes the need to assess dispersion
Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces.
quiz.explanation: 對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環境老化與殘餘能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀；若出現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Performance specifications and method handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「性能規格與試法交接」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Performance specifications and method handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。梁試驗和板試驗有不同裂縫路徑，不能直接換算；交接應保留版本、曲線和取樣方向，讓維修材料採用同一性能語言。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移；若出現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「性能規格與試法交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A joule requirement without panel size, supports and terminal displacement lacks a comparable physical meaning. Beams and panels form different crack paths and are not directly interchangeable. Preserve method editions, curves and sampling directions so repair materials use the same performance definition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Performance specifications and method handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「性能規格與試法交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance specifications and method handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「性能規格與試法交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Performance specifications and method handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Performance specifications and method handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「性能規格與試法交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Performance specifications and method handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
